claims.summary: Subclass 189 points-tested stream is permanent; invitation requires eligible occupation, skills assessment, age under 45, English and at least 65 points, but minimum points do not guarantee invitation.

limitations: Official page only indexed in this pass; application fee, current processing, citizenship/residence details not established.

claims.summary: The Georgian Agency states a work residence permit may issue to an alien carrying out entrepreneurial activities in Georgia or a registered labour immigrant. Evidence must show legal monthly income/remuneration of at least five times the average-consumer subsistence level; an alien-founded enterprise must show annual turnover of at least GEL 50,000 per applicant (GEL 35,000 for education/medical enterprises), plus the stated registration and staffing evidence.

financialRequirements.description: Annual employer/alien-founded enterprise turnover per work-residence applicant; not personal income. Educational or medical enterprises: GEL 35,000 per applicant.

limitations: Applicant must meet separate legal monthly-income formula (fivefold average-consumer subsistence minimum; no amount encoded because it varies), labour-immigrant registration where applicable, and other requirements. This is entrepreneurial/work residence, not investment residence.

suggestedCorrections.reason: USD 300,000 investment threshold belongs to a different investment-residence product, not this entrepreneurial/work-residence route.
The applicable work-residence income test is formula-based (fivefold current average-consumer subsistence minimum), not a fixed USD floor.

claims.summary: Hong Kong TTPS allows eligible Category A high-income applicants (HKD 2.5m prior-year annual income), Category B graduates of eligible universities with 3 years' experience, or Category C recent eligible graduates subject to quota; job offer is not required at application. Initial stay is 36 months for A and 24 months for B/C.

financialRequirements.description: Prior-year income qualification for Category A only

limitations: Category B/C depend on current eligible university list; further stay requires employment/business evidence. PR/citizenship not verified.

claims.summary: Japan's Business Manager criteria were amended effective 16 October 2025.
